items.title: Harold Mabern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 31, 2010
items.q: The interviewer asks 'Dexter Gordon.' and the interviewee responds 'You name it. You know what I mean?' indicating recognition but no described personal or professional interaction in the text.

ctx.x: Jones, Frank Foster, Benny Golson, Slide Hampton. You know, certain ones, if I’ve got to play some of that music, get it to me ten weeks ahead of time, you know. So I told Art, I said, “Well you know Art, you know you’re playing all those hard piano parts.” So Benny said, “Don’t worry, Mabern, we’re kind of getting away from that.” Because this time, this would have been the third Jazztet from the original with McCoy Tyner. Then Cedar. Now I’m coming it and that’s the third Jazztet. So sure enough they cut back…
You name it. You know what I mean?
